# SentinelOps

> Open-source verification platform that turns natural-language specifications into machine-checked proofs enforced at AI runtime.

SentinelOps builds Provability Fabric and a suite of related tools (Spec-to-Proof, SpecCursor, SpecSync, Lean Toolchain, Runtime Safety Kernels, Security Envelopes, Model Asset Guard) that give AI agents mathematical guarantees about their behavior.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the SentinelOps platform and Provability Fabric.
- [Products](/products): The verification suite includes Provability Fabric, Spec-to-Proof, SpecCursor, SpecSync, Lean Toolchain, Runtime Safety Kernels, Security Envelopes, and Model Asset Guard.
- [Mission](/mission): Vision, principles, and roadmap for provably safe AI.
